laws.name: Zero Hard Coding
laws.text: Nothing shall be hardcoded except constitutional primitives. No business, industry, country, language, currency, or marketplace concept shall be embedded in the platform. Everything shall be derived.

laws.name: Knowledge Once
laws.text: Every concept, capability, relationship, semantic meaning, policy, rule, and authority shall be defined exactly once. Duplication is prohibited.

laws.name: Projection Law
laws.text: The platform stores primitives. The runtime projects realities. Business constructs, applications, interfaces, processes, and commercial objects are projections. Everything beyond primitives is derived.

laws.name: Constitutional Governance
laws.text: Every capability, change, evolution, and autonomous action must be governed. No execution may bypass governance.

laws.name: Explainability
laws.text: Every action must answer what happened, why, who authorized it, which policy allowed it, what evidence supports it, what confidence exists, and what alternatives were evaluated.

laws.name: Ownership
laws.text: No concept may exist without ownership. No capability without boundary. No boundary without contract. No contract without governance.

laws.name: Semantic Singularity
laws.text: No semantic term may exist with multiple meanings. No meaning may exist with multiple canonical definitions. No overlap may exist between constitutional domains.

laws.name: Dependency Flow
laws.text: Identity to Knowledge to Relationships to Context to Policy to Trust to Projection. Circular dependencies, mutual ownership, and cross-domain state mutation are forbidden.

laws.name: Truth Ownership
laws.text: No projection may own truth. Truth belongs only to constitutional domains. Products, services, offers, subscriptions, and contracts are projections.

laws.name: Architectural Freeze
laws.text: Primitives, domain ownership, contract structure, governance model, dependency model, and projection model are frozen. Future changes occur through registries, policies, capabilities, contexts, relationships, knowledge, agents, and projections — never through primitive expansion.

verification.enforcement: A projection that fails audit is not a release. The audit is the constitution made executable.
